answer: For jobs labeling cedar and willow seedlings, require each agent to lock a bond beyond the audit horizon. Randomly assign independent reviewers to hidden test images; repeated, verified fraud forfeits the bond after an appeal. Cap each identity's rewards during the lock below its bond. Opening N identities then immobilizes N bonds, and dishonest work risks a net loss. This raises the capital cost of a sybil swarm; it does not prove one human per account.
